components_instructions.simulator_card: Apply surface_styles.glass. Make it the visual centerpiece. Use a Bento-like split: Inputs on the left (col-span-12 md:col-span-7), Results on the right (col-span-12 md:col-span-5) with a deeper background like bg-[#05070A] inside the glass card.

sections_instructions.navigation: Sticky top, crystal glass effect. Use a refined text-based logo for 'Hipotecas San Sebastián' in Playfair Display.
sections_instructions.hero: Dark overlay on the classic architecture image (bg-black/60). Asymmetric layout. H1 on the left. Subtle scroll indicator. Emphasize USD and coverage (CABA & GBA).
sections_instructions.simulator: Use Shadcn slider (customized with gold primary color) for inputs. Show side-by-side comparison or toggle of Francés vs Americano. Emphasize the max 35% LTV rules.
sections_instructions.about_us: Bento Grid layout (Tetris). Big serif numbers for '35 Años' and '1000+ Hipotecas'. Image of contract signing in one of the bento boxes.
sections_instructions.how_it_works: Editorial ribbon or clean vertical steps. Clean typography. Emphasize CABA & GBA coverage, and 60 months max term.
sections_instructions.faq: Shadcn accordion. Minimalist borders. Provide simple, serious answers about the systems and requirements.
sections_instructions.contact: Form strictly using defined inputs style. Submit must send to sansebastianhipotecas@gmail.com (mocked or resend setup).
sections_instructions.footer: Massive typography 'Hipotecas San Sebastián' at the bottom (text-[8vw]). Darker than background. WhatsApp CTA.

hero_background.description: Grand classic building with columns to establish heritage and institutional trust.

about_bento_2.description: Signing contract document for trust building.

motion.framer_motion: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fades. Keep animations slow and serious, not bouncy. E.g., `transition: { duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }`
